name: aether-azion
author: hi@amogusreal.tech
description: 🥚 aether-azion — free Minecraft hosting fork optimised for Azion Cloud. Auto-detects existing Paper/Vanilla installations.

variables.name: Additional Flags
variables.description: JVM flag preset. Aikar's Flags = best for Paper/Purpur. Velocity Flags = best for proxies. ZGC (Java 21+) = ultra-low GC pauses for large RAM or tick-sensitive servers.

variables.name: Automatic Updating
variables.description: Automatically update your server software to the latest build available for the running version. Feature based from https://github.com/mcjars/pterodactyl-yolks.

variables.name: Maximum Ram Percentage
variables.description: Decide how much of your servers ram to allocate for Minecraft usage. On Azion free-tier, keep this at 80 or below to leave headroom for the OS.

variables.name: SIMD Operations Support
variables.description: Add support for SIMD Operations by adding --add-modules=jdk.incubator.vector, used in forks like Pufferfish or Purpur for improved map rendering performance. (Java 16-21)

variables.name: Discord URL (ADMIN ONLY)
variables.description: Your Discord Server Invite Code. Does not change the MOTD URL. If for example your Discord Server is located at discord.gg/valorant, put "valorant" here.

variables.name: Email (ADMIN ONLY)
variables.description: Your support email, shown below the Discord URL Link.

variables.name: Hosting Name (ADMIN ONLY)
variables.description: Your hosting name. Required for forced MOTD to work.

variables.name: Enable Forced MOTD (ADMIN ONLY)
variables.description: A switch to enable the Forced MOTD feature in aether. Requires Discord URL and Hosting Name to be set. This setting can be bypassed by users by using a plugin or mod that interacts with the MOTD such as MiniMOTD or ServerListPlus.

variables.name: Optimize Server (ADMIN ONLY)
variables.description: This switch enables the optimization feature for Minecraft: Java Edition servers using a custom Hibernation plugin. By enabling this option, you agree that this egg contacts GitHub to pull the latest version.

variables.name: Enable Rules (ADMIN ONLY)
variables.description: A switch to enable the built-in rules in aether. For more information, please check the documentation.

variables.name: MCJars API Key (ADMIN ONLY)
variables.description: Your MCJars API Key, not required.

variables.name: Forced MOTD Line 1 (ADMIN ONLY)
variables.description: First line of the server MOTD shown in the Minecraft server list. Overrides any user changes on every restart. Supports §-color codes (e.g. §6§lMy Server). Leave empty to let users set their own MOTD.

variables.name: Forced MOTD Line 2 (ADMIN ONLY)
variables.description: Second line of the server MOTD. Only used if Forced MOTD Line 1 is also set.

variables.name: Server Icon URL (ADMIN ONLY)
variables.description: URL to a 64x64 PNG image used as the server icon in the Minecraft server list. Downloaded and applied on every restart — users cannot permanently change it. Host on Imgur, GitHub raw, or any public CDN.

variables.name: Max CPU Cores (ADMIN ONLY)
variables.description: Limit how many CPU cores the JVM can use (-XX:ActiveProcessorCount). Prevents Java from monopolising all vCPUs on shared Azion nodes. Set to 0 to let the JVM auto-detect (default).
